measurement_contract.mechanical: Pinned retrieval path parity only; not model quality or actual agent trial. File/existing extracted index/native Dolt use identical graph edges.
measurement_contract.agent: External real model command receives frozen task and pinned source bundle; exact structured labelled answer required. Record model/prompt/tool config and raw output; never infer model execution from mechanical retrieval.
measurement_contract.cold: Fresh worker process and no application cache; OS page cache is not flushed.
measurement_contract.warm: Repeated requests in the same worker; OS page cache is not controlled.
measurement_contract.memory: Linux ru_maxrss for worker and largest waited child; not simultaneous process-tree RSS.
measurement_contract.io: /proc/self/io read/write counters and resource block operations; no claim of physical device bytes.
measurement_contract.setup: Measured repository creation, initial extraction and graph sync, corpus and database byte counts; excluded from query latency but separately reported.

corpus_lock.correction: Retain the historical-blindness repair from 1.0.1. Add explicit nominal evidence_id metadata to each authored evidence record, distinct from the ticket citation target. The first 48 real model trials chose citation targets or omitted evidence IDs: 0/48 exact labels, but 48/48 outcome/scope/inference fields matched in both arms. Those receipts remain retained as failures. This repairs missing record-identity metadata, not answers: task prompts, expected labels, partitions, thresholds and the model system prompt/schema remain unchanged. Freeze this corpus revision before new measurements and calls.
corpus_lock.previous_reports: Prior mechanical runs and real model receipts are retained with their original failures and input hashes; never relabelled as passes.

measurement_contract.cold: fresh worker for each task; whole worker elapsed including native session startup and close; application caches cold, OS page cache not flushed
measurement_contract.warm: one worker per project/backend, repeated task sequence; identical Git source material reads included; native session startup retained separately
measurement_contract.retrieval: exact expected source path list at frozen old/current Git revision; identical context payload and source ordering; all rows must be correct
measurement_contract.context_identity: exact historical revision plus path/content; old-release excludes later-correction.json and future observed/recorded timestamps
measurement_contract.p95: sorted nearest rank ceil(N*0.95), clamped to valid array index
measurement_contract.ratios: dolt-warm versus file-warm, not versus existing index; ratio denominator must be nonzero
measurement_contract.memory_limit: ru_maxrss worker and largest waited child are not simultaneous process-tree peak. Live native RSS is a sampled within-row sum only; never sum historical maxima from different times.
measurement_contract.io_limit: UTF-8 reconstructed source/context byte counts and /proc/self/io/resource counters are proxies, not actual tokens or physical device IO
measurement_contract.agent_inputs: expected_* labels omitted; same decision-time source bundle, matched model/tool/prompt/access budget; source injection stays untrusted evidence
measurement_contract.agent_verdict: exact structured equality to unchanged task labels; importer requires all 48 baseline/candidate labels and unique invocations, hashes, contained transcripts and current corpus lock
measurement_contract.candidate_acceptance: zero known deterministic correctness regression and no unresolved candidate failure; strict importer both-arm failure must remain recorded separately from candidate assessment
measurement_contract.exports: exported payload is input evidence only, never model execution evidence

retained_local_assessment.scope: Reviewed frozen local candidate profile; not a claim that the baseline model is perfect or that production workloads were evaluated
criteria_source: docs/kctx/handover.md §14: no correctness regression and no new unresolved candidate failures
retained_local_assessment.decision: candidate meets the frozen local correctness and cost criteria
retained_local_assessment.strict_importer_disposition: Nonzero is retained: the checker requires perfect labels in both arms; baseline atlas-07 answered incomplete instead of unknown. No candidate failure, label edit, threshold change, prompt change, or model retry was used to remove it.
limits: Synthetic corpus; 24 tasks across two projects; one independent call per arm/task
Model routing alias default recorded; resolved provider model and actual token usage not exposed
Cold startup and native memory costs remain in the measurement report; Dolt is not faster than the warm existing index

comparison_rules: Correctness and complete response parity precede timing comparisons.
Use identical source snapshots, task ordering, context payloads and temperature profile for Python/Rust; no query-plan changes disguised as language speedups.
Record exact product binary/tool/dependency/input identities, repeated-process ownership and failure attempts.
No changed labels, post-hoc threshold changes or unrecorded model retries.
Unrun, failed or externally attested reports remain explicitly attributed.
Prior synthetic 23/24 versus 24/24 with equal retrieved payloads is not evidence of Dolt-caused reasoning improvement.

unavailable_scope.production_corpus: absent; synthetic held-out partition is not a representative production review/authoring/investigation corpus
unavailable_scope.resolved_model_identity: retained harness records default routing alias, not resolved provider model
unavailable_scope.hardware_bound_new_budgets: not supplied; historical milliseconds are context, not new machine thresholds
unavailable_scope.gate_effect: P00/WF00 freezes available synthetic inputs only. Full P11/WF15 outcome/resource claims remain unrun until production-scope and budget prerequisites are explicitly supplied.
